title: Chunking strategy
content: NeuroFlow uses adaptive sentence-aware chunking. The fixed-size strategy uses the cl100k_base tokenizer, a maximum chunk size of 512 tokens, and an overlap of 64 tokens. When extracted pages contain heading levels such as h1, the chunker selects hierarchical chunking and records section and parent metadata. When a document has more than 50 pages, semantic chunking may be selected. CSV pages are treated as tables and use fixed-size chunking. Each persisted chunk receives a database-generated UUID that is distinct from its document UUID.
